copy.intro: Silver 2020 GLA250 4MATIC with a turbocharged 2.0 L engine, a dual-clutch automatic and a backup camera for tight city parking spots.

faq.question: How many seats does the GLA250 have?
Does the GLA250 have a backup camera?
faq.answer: Yes. A backup camera is listed in its equipment, along with Bluetooth and cruise control.

faq.question: Can you deliver the GLA250 to me?
faq.answer: Yes. We deliver to any address. The delivery fee is $75 plus a charge for distance. You can also collect it from us at no charge.

faq.question: What do I need to rent the GLA250?
faq.answer: You need an Ontario G or G2 licence and a credit card in your name. We check your licence and identity before pickup.

copy.intro: Black G63 AMG with four-wheel drive and seats for five. A boxy SUV that gets noticed at the curb and suits a snowy week.

faq.question: How many people fit in the G63 AMG?

faq.answer: Yes. Four-wheel drive helps on snowy and icy roads. Leave extra time and drive to the conditions.
